messages:
deploy-bot: Rolling update started for service `model-serving` image `redwood/model-serving:v3.4.2`.
deploy-bot: Traffic plan: 10% -> 50% in 30m increments if health OK. Change window: 2h. Triggered by maria.
maria: @team starting watch. I'll keep p50/p95/p99 on the SLO dashboard and errorbudget chart :eyes:
aj: I'll keep an eye on routing and kv-cache evictions. ping me if retries spike.
oncall-bot: ALERT: p99 latency for model-serving (eu-west) 520ms > 300ms threshold. 5xx rate 0.95% (baseline 0.12%). Occurred at 1811112238
sophia: Seeing same on traces, tail latencies from the embed path. Increasing queueing on GPU nodes.
ram: suggest pause roll forward. Can we revert traffic to v3.4.1? What's the diff? @maria
maria: Hold canary at 10%. @deploy-bot pause-rollout
deploy-bot: Received pause. Traffic frozen at 10%. Notifying infra team.
aj: Running quick canary logs: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=model-serving -c model` shows OOM-ish GC logs on a few pods.
sophia: Also saw a minor change in kernel selection that landed in v3.4.2 reconcilers. Might be related.
maria: Decision: Do not roll forward. We'll pin traffic back to v3.4.1 for safety. @deploy-bot rollback-to `redwood/model-serving:v3.4.1`
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated. Estimated completion 2m. Posting release-note draft to #eng-releases: "v3.4.2 rolled back due to p99 latency regression in eu-west canary; investigating kernel selector change"
oncall-bot: INFO: errorbudget burn halted. current errorbudget remaining 98.1%
ram: Create a short postmortem note and hold off next deploy until kernel-selector revert tests pass. @sophia can you bisect?
sophia: On it. Will create a branch with the kernel change reverted and run small-scale repro.
maria: Thanks all. Labeling this roll action as "hold-and-roll-back" in the release tracker. :thumbsup:
